concept.controls: Arrows/WASD: fire that way and get kicked the opposite way. Space: fire your loaded Star Cannon.
concept.core_mechanic: Recoil flight. Every shot blasts the rocket backwards, so aiming, dodging, and flying are the same action. Asteroids are indestructible bumpers that ricochet your shots around corners into aliens you could not hit directly.
concept.juice: Huge flame squash on every shot, drifting shell casings, and a short screen kick in the recoil direction. Ricochet kills pop floating text like "PING! +200" and "THROUGH TWO!" Aliens burst into green rings, asteroids spark and ring like bells, and a caught star makes the rocket glow and trail sparkles. The title screen shows "RECOIL ROCKET" bouncing side to side as the idle rocket fires by itself.
concept.lose: Three aliens slip past and hit the planet, or the rocket crashes three times. You see "THE PLANET WAS OVERWHELMED."
concept.pitch: Your cannon is also your engine — every shot launches you backwards across space! Bounce blasts off asteroids, blast the aliens, and keep them away from your planet for 90 seconds.

roles.role: Your ship, moved entirely by the recoil from its own cannon.
Wobbling invaders that drift, zigzag, and finally dive toward the planet.
The fragile purple planet anchored at bottom-center; it cracks a little more each time an alien reaches it.
A power-up dropped by special aliens. Fly through it to load one piercing Star Cannon shot that passes through everything in a line.
Unbreakable floating bumpers that deflect your shots and damage your rocket if you slam into them.

concept.title: Recoil Rocket
concept.win: Survive the full 90-second invasion. You see "YOU SAVED THE PLANET!"

playtest.advice: Winnable, and no dumb policy wins.

minor: Floating +100 score text briefly overlaps the center controls hint in mid-play capture, momentary effect overlap

runs.summary: Recoil Rocket is a 90-second space shooter where every shot blasts your rocket backwards, so you aim, dodge, and fly with the same cannon — bouncing blasts off indestructible asteroids into wobbling aliens, catching dropped stars, and keeping invaders away from the purple planet at the bottom. Play with Arrows/WASD to fire in that direction (and get kicked the opposite way), ricochet shots for bonus “PING!” points, fly through a star to load the piercing Star Cannon and fire it with Space, and survive the full invasion without letting three aliens hit the planet or crashing three times.
